title: Lear tips KLAS about F-117

tellings.quote: He had told my boss, Ned Day, managing editor, about this amazing plane that was invisible to radar flying up at Tonopah and Area 51.

plain: Around 1987, according to the Las Vegas television journalist George Knapp, a man named John Lear told Knapp's boss at the station KLAS, the managing editor Ned Day, about "this amazing plane that was invisible to radar" flying out of Tonopah and Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in the Nevada desert. Knapp tells this as something that happened in his own newsroom; the plane was the F-117 stealth jet, then still secret, and the point of the story is that Lear knew of it before the public did, which lends weight to his other tips.
